question: Can a complete C0 account distinguish a literal anatomical head/part referent and its locally scoped clearing/removal effect from a generic beneficial effect or a mere incoming influence relation?
recommended_family: Anatomical HEAD as a literal part noun, with separately written owner, route/from-region and negative scope; not an exported prefix or invented generic effect function.

source_comparison.source: Furnivall-edited Sloane73 Quinte Essence Q1, BookI pp2–3/editorial11r–11v
source_comparison.actual_claim: Aries/Taurus/Gemini stars influence Gerapigra galieni. That medicine draws superfluous humours from head, neck and breast, explicitly not from members beneath. Separate lower-region spices receive influence from Capricorn/Aquarius/Pisces.
source_comparison.asymmetry: Influence on a drug is not removal from a person. Its upper-region removal excludes a lower-region endpoint; neither identity, region nor polarity may be silently inverted.
source_comparison.limits: One c1460–70 manuscript mediated by Furnivall; no new collation, exact pre1450 exemplar or named Sun actor in the drug example.

source_comparison.actual_claim: Raw cabbage juice by itself, introduced into the nostrils, clears the head. The same entry separately states bowel-softening under juice+iris+nitron swallowed and numerous other routes/endpoints.
source_comparison.exact_local_clause: ἐγχεόμενός τε καθʼ ἑαυτὸν ταῖς ῥισὶ κεφαλὴν καθαίρει
source_comparison.asymmetry: Nose is an application route; head is the stated affected region. They are not interchangeable arguments. Other routes/effects prevent universal HEAD-only benefit for the named plant.
source_comparison.limits: Wellmann Greek edition/digitalTEI, not independently collated medieval wording. It does NOT explicitly say the nasal branch has no lower-body effect.

common_literal_content: Both passages really name the anatomical head as an affected region. Shared endpoint reference is firmer than shared operation: DRAW_AWAY humours and CLEAR_HEAD are not one proved historical verb or process. The common noun does not merge medicines, routes, body instances or medical traditions.
actual_contrary_accounts: One incoming INFLUENCE relation alone omits removal, region selection and exclusion in Sloane73.
One beneficial-effect state for an entire drug/person erases region/route scope.
Nose=head, or every body part=one interchangeable place, changes the Dioscorides recipient statement.
No-lower-effect for every cabbage application imports Sloane73’s negative into an unrelated preparation.
candidate_asymmetric_written_consequence: In a proposed head-region removal clause, redirecting its affected-region reference to a lower member must not retain the same asserted Sloane73 positive. In the Dioscorides clause, changing the route argument from nose to the head-region slot loses the actual source relation. These are source-content bookkeeping countercases, not predicted medical outcomes or target evidence.

one_concrete_next_action.action: If root selects this question, assign one bounded whole C0 authoring attempt over the already owned complete f89v1.13–20 plus both complete f68r2 rings, requiring an anatomical part/region and a separately expressed region-selective removal statement beyond the old class-level INFLUENCE relay. Freeze exact whole entries and the unchanged source scope before authoring; report UNKNOWN when the paragraph cannot supply the owner, affected region, source region or negative. Do not select a HEAD string from image resemblance or force it into the rings.
one_concrete_next_action.reason_for_named_scope: This is the existing cross-genre pair behind IDEA765, with a documented complete-input stop and a concrete source duty left unmet; not a new incidence scan or target acquisition.
one_concrete_next_action.expansion: None; root nomination/selection required. No extra paragraph, source unit, decoder, image or reserve after failure.
one_concrete_next_action.gain: A genuinely complete region-selective written continuation would meet a previously missing content obligation and distinguish a region-sensitive account from an influence-only relay. Reuse must occur in actual supported target forms; a one-off HEAD gloss gains no productive-family credit.
one_concrete_next_action.failure: Unwritten endpoints/negative, unknown words or unpaid referent switches leave the account partial and IDEA765 unselected. Contradiction rejects only its frozen conjunction. Ordinary prose and alternative semantic accounts remain competitors. No capacity PASS or zero-unknown declaration selects a meaning.

qualification_of_recommendation: This is a conditional authoring input, not a ready confirmatory experiment: no existing target form is independently bound to HEAD, CLEAR or a lower-member negative. Root may reasonably decline another freely filled dictionary. The additional Dioscorides source constraint alone does not satisfy IDEA765 reopening.
